title: Simultaneous Inference for Partially Observed Functional Time Series
summary: Functional data analysis (FDA) provides statistical methods for analyzing samples of time-continuous stochastic processes. Measurements often arise in the form of sensor data for a key scientific variable. The practical problem of irregular sensor disruptions has fostered interest in analyzing partially observed random functions. Specifically, this paper is motivated by a time series of intermittently missing pollution data with dependence along pollution paths and missingness patterns.
